notes.title: Filming begins for Dekker 2
notes.content: [p]Filming began last weekend for Dekker 2 with new patient Ophelia played by Sydney Skye and familiar face Marianna reprised by Aislinn De'Ath. Marianna plays your assistant this time around and pops up in a few places, including the couch, to help you through the game. Don't get too cosy though as she's also a suspect for both murders :o[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275985/aeb6aa1ef28525bef849f301a34de5f3fee5729a.jpg"][/img](Behind the scenes with Marianna, Aislinn De'Ath)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275985/0bad38c528821f4fff49185f22b8ed8223c0cab7.png"][/img](Behind the scenes with Ophelia, Sydney Skye)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275985/2caf7ad4a64caed960f0bd9df65ac94bcb844418.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Filming continues into September - stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939680/The_Infectious_Madness_of_Doctor_Dekker_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cast revealed for The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275985/1eb5c0d3f29ef166b88e4909d3f4b970d856b346.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re happy to announce the full main cast for The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2![/p][p][/p][p]The new cast are Paul Baverstock [i](Not For Broadcast)[/i],[i] [/i]Harry Bradley [i](The Mousetrap)[/i], Anna Fraser [i](Murderous Muses)[/i], Beth Gatherer [i](Murderous Muses)[/i], and Sydney Skye. They join Aislinn De’Ath ([i]Midnight Caller[/i]), who was announced last year and has appeared in all four of our previous games. [/p][p][/p][p][b]About the cast and characters[/b][/p][p]Paul Baverstock, best known to gamers as [i]Not For Broadcast[/i]’s Jeremy Donaldson, makes his return to the FMV fold as KILLIAN, a compulsive gambler who tries to code around the bookie’s odds, but instead ends up further in debt and consumed by his visions.[/p][p]
Harry Bradley comes fresh from Agatha Christie’s [i]The Mousetrap[/i] in London’s West End to make his videogame debut as DUNE, a 1930’s styled police detective who’s lost his memories but still seeks to unravel the truth behind the recent murders and his own identity crisis.[/p][p][/p][p]Aislinn De’Ath reprises her role as MARIANNA, and returns as a reformed assistant to the player, helping with their investigation whilst pursuing a secret mission of her own. Aislinn portrayed Violet in [i]The Shapeshifting Detective [/i]and [i]Dark Nights with Poe and Munro[/i], as well as Lilith in [i]Murderous Muses. [/i][/p][p][/p][p]Anna Fraser, who previously played Sunday and Monday Finch in [i]Murderous Muses [/i]takes on the role of SAPHIRA, a mysterious scientist and euthanasia specialist with a long and gothic family history. [/p][p][/p][p]Beth Gatherer plays forest-dwelling healer BRIDGET, whose unconventional methods have landed her in trouble with the police. Beth featured as Professor Catherine Myers in [i]Murderous Muses [/i]and regularly performs murder mystery roles.[/p][p][/p][p]The cast is rounded out by Sydney Skye as OPHELIA, a sculptor who is haunted by voices in the walls of her childhood home. Sydney has numerous credits in film, theater and voiceover and has most recently been touring as Alice in [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Filming begins in August - don't forget to wishlist! [/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939680/The_Infectious_Madness_of_Doctor_Dekker_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
